exposure: Peripheral Perfusion Index (PPI) before spinal anaesthesia
outcome: uterine contraction (using Linear Analogue Scale - LAS)
cohort: The study included 65 pregnant patients classified as American Society of Anaesthesiology II (ASA II) who underwent caesarean section at Hasan Sadikin General Hospital.
finding: Pre-anaesthesia Peripheral Perfusion Index (PPI) showed a strong positive correlation with total vasopressor administration, a moderate positive correlation with nausea and vomiting, and a moderate negative correlation with uterine contractions, demonstrating its utility as a predictor for these outcomes and hypotension (with a cut-off value of 3.5).
cross-section timing: Peripheral Perfusion Index (PPI) was measured before spinal anaesthesia, and outcomes were monitored intraoperatively during caesarean section.
